featured_reviews.name: Vinayvijayji Maharajsaheb
featured_reviews.review_text:
Equipment is quite new and well-maintained (most machines are 2023–2025 models)
Very decent free-weight section: plenty of dumbbells up to 60 kg, good rack availability even at 7–9 PM
Air-conditioned properly (huge plus in Mumbai summer + monsoon)
Trainers are knowledgeable and not the typical “bro, 5 more reps” pushy type — they actually correct form without ego
Group classes (especially Combat Fit, HIIT, and Yoga) are genuinely high quality — the instructors are certified and not just playing loud music
Changing rooms & washrooms are cleaned 3–4 times a day, almost always smell neutral (rare!)
Good amount of cardio options — Assault bikes, SkiErgs, good rowers, 12+ treadmills
What could be better:
Peak hours (7–10 AM & 6:30–9:30 PM) can get crowded — leg press, cable machines and functional area feel cramped
Only 2 squat racks in the main area (they really need 3–4 now with the crowd growth)
Protein shake / café counter is overpriced even by gym standards (₹220 for average whey + milk)
Music playlist is very repetitive — after 2 months you can predict the next song 😅
No proper towel service anymore (they removed it in late 2025)

featured_reviews.review_text:
1/5 stars – Poor Management and Facilities Undermine the Experience
Advertised hours are until 11 PM, but the gym starts shutting down lights as early as 10:30 PM, making it impossible for late-arriving members (like those coming after work at 9-9:30 PM) to complete a full workout. Lights go off in phases: half at 10:30, more at 10:45, and fully off 5 minutes before closing—often without checking if anyone is still exercising or retrieving belongings. This is unsafe and frustrating.
Additionally, about half the equipment is damaged or poorly maintained, especially high-use items like benches for dumbbell presses and several machines. Cooling is inadequate, with fans/AC not functioning properly, leading to an uncomfortable environment.
Trainers prioritize their own schedules over member needs, citing personal commutes as reasons for early closures. We pay for access and facilities, not excuses—members aren't responsible for staff logistics.
For the price, this gym falls short; even budget options (e.g., 3 months for ₹1000) offer better reliability. Owners/management: Fix the basics—hours enforcement, equipment repairs, cooling, and trainer accountability—before pushing memberships. featured_reviews.name: sagar dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing an honest review about Image Fitness.

The gym has a great location, advanced equipment, and supportive staff. The overall environment has good potential, but there are several important issues that need immediate attention.  Membership should come with a good experience ,  not daily compromises.

Points that need serious improvement:

1. Poor management and hygiene
The changing room and steam room are not maintained properly. Cleanliness is a basic expectation in any fitness center.
2. Cardio equipment maintenance issues
In the cardio section, the cycle seat adjustment and thrust lever are not working properly, making workouts uncomfortable and inconvenient.
3. Unsafe elliptical machine
One of the elliptical machines is damaged where the foot is placed. During momentum, the footing slips and causes imbalance, which can lead to serious injury. The machine itself is also not balanced properly on the ground.
4. AC not functioning throughout summer — major concern
The air conditioning has not been working properly during the entire summer. When asked, trainers casually respond with “it’s a machine, sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn’t.” This is not the kind of answer expected after paying full membership fees.
“A gym should make you sweat because of workouts, not because the AC gave up.”
5. Re-racking discipline is missing
Weights are left scattered everywhere. During rush hours, a lot of workout time gets wasted just searching for plates and dumbbells.
“Finding weights in this gym feels harder than lifting them.”
6. Broken dumbbell rack — safety hazard
The dumbbell rack is damaged and unstable. Some holders are broken, and the rack shakes while placing dumbbells back. This can become a major safety issue and may cause injuries anytime.
7. Space management issue
Personally, I feel the gym is overcrowded with equipment, leaving less free workout space and making movement uncomfortable during peak hours.

Image Fitness has the potential to be one of the best gyms in the area, but maintenance, cleanliness, safety, and management should be treated as priorities, not afterthoughts.

Team Maharashtra Fitness Club
